requirement.description: The View class incorrectly rejects valid Signal objects as "not data views" when they should be accepted. The logic fails to properly detect when a Signal represents a valid data view.
requirement.contract: When a Signal is passed as a target to View constructor, it should be accepted if it's a valid data view (i.e., has a layout that can be cast to a layout and matches the provided layout size). The error message should be more precise about what constitutes a valid data view.

requirement.description: The warning message format in EnumMeta doesn't match the expected format in test assertions. The warning message should include the specific format expected by the test suite.
requirement.contract: When a signed value is used with an unsigned enumeration shape, the warning message should match the expected format exactly: "Value -1 of enumeration member 'A' is signed, but the enumeration shape is unsigned(1)" instead of the current format.

requirement.description: ArrayLayout indexing behavior doesn't properly validate when indexing with non-value objects. It raises a generic TypeError instead of the expected message format.
requirement.contract: When indexing an ArrayLayout with a non-value object, it should raise a TypeError with the exact message: "Only views with array layout, not StructLayout({}), may be indexed with a value"

requirement.description: The error message for missing attributes in View.__getattr__ doesn't match expected format. The error message should suggest similar field names and follow the expected format.
requirement.contract: The View.__getattr__ method should provide an error message that follows the exact format: "View of (sig $signal) does not have a field 'a'; did you mean one of: 'b', 'c'?"

requirement.description: The _convert_to_int method doesn't properly handle conversion errors from ShapeCastable.const() methods, particularly when processing invalid hex strings like "aa".
requirement.contract: The _convert_to_int method should properly handle invalid constant conversions from ShapeCastable objects and provide clearer error messages when the resulting constant doesn't match the expected shape.
